generate_tabert_training_data: run the script to generate vanilla TableBert pretraining data from a JSONL table corpus for multiple epochs
generate_for_epoch: generate pretraining instances for a single epoch and save token sequences and masked LM labels to an HDF5 shard file
create_input_formatter: create a VanillaTableBertInputFormatter with a config and tokenizer to convert table examples into pretraining instances
load_table_database: load a TableDatabase from a JSONL corpus with memory backend and a subset of table indices for distributed processing
split_corpus_train_dev: split the table corpus indices into train and dev sets with a 10 percent dev split across distributed workers
